data.gender_notes: Cheshta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Cheshta is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chetana' meaning consciousness or awareness. The name Cheshta symbolizes the power of intention and the ability to manifest one's desires. It is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom. The name Cheshta carries the meaning “Wish, Desire, Intention” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Cheshta usually hope their child will grow to embody wish, desire, intention and live with faith, good character and purpose.
